drift_points.expected: The APP_SETTINGS file value overrides the from_object default
drift_points.actual: from_envvar is a shortcut for from_pyfile: it execs the file named by APP_SETTINGS and hands the resulting module to from_object. If that file does not assign SECRET_KEY (or assigns it as a non-uppercase name), the value loaded earlier from default_settings persists untouched
override_chain: default_config (src/flask/app.py) -> make_config -> from_object -> from_envvar -> from_pyfile -> from_object -> direct assignment

drift_points.expected: The env-specific config file overrides the False default that ships in Flask.default_config
drift_points.actual: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE defaults to False in the default_config ImmutableDict (src/flask/app.py), copied into the Config instance by make_config (src/flask/sansio/app.py) before any from_object/from_envvar call. Because Config is a plain dict, a later layer only overrides the key if the loaded module actually assigns it as an UPPERCASE attribute; from_object silently skips everything else
override_chain: default_config (src/flask/app.py) -> make_config -> from_object -> from_envvar -> from_pyfile -> from_object
